title: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Ordinance 1982

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Ordinance 1982
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXV of 1982
CODE OF CRIMINAL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1982
ORDINANCE XXV of 1982
An Ordinance
further to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 12th October, 1982]
No. F. 17(1)/82-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the Present is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Code of Criminal
Procedure (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Ordinance 1982
sections.description:
Amendment of section 32, Act V of 1898

ORDINANCE XXV of 1982
CODE OF CRIMINAL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1982
ORDINANCE XXV of 1982
An Ordinance
further to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 12th October, 1982]
No. F. 17(1)/82-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the Present is hereby published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 32,
Act V of 1898.- In the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (,Act V of 1898),
in section 32, in subsection (1), for the words "five thousand" the
words "fifteen thousand", for the words "one thousand" the
words "five thousand" and for the word "fifty" the words
"one thousand" shall respectively be substituted.
